translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: 1 TESALONAIKA
book.title: Folo yana leta nagona TESALONAIKA tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Yesu yana yewaꞋela faꞋina wanalulauboda.
Siule tobohiyameyao, keke vaita gava tova o kaꞋi gava aituha Kaiwabu Yesu ginayewaꞋela-ma faꞋine anaꞋetoladini, keke.
FaꞋina omi taumiyao wahalamane-hagihagiyena tokaiꞋafu bogi againe tonimanuwa ginavefutaꞋana amine, Kaiwabu yana yewaꞋela tova kaliva ginavefutaꞋadi.

Kaliva hinagahegahe hinagayo, “Fafali moyaꞋaina agaidiya niwalova gisena. Keke tamo vita kananuhagani.” Hidedemi hinagahegahe tu auheꞋama agolaufofola lakahina badi agaidiya ginalakayemu. Kwamayoku wahifugadi auheꞋama hinavefahedi be yadi aulolo ginayemu amine, meda badi tomiyababi agaidiya aulolo lakahi-moꞋena ginalakayemu ada keke adifaiweya hinaꞋota.
Tu omi tobohiyameyao Yesu yana yoꞋogaga agaidiya keke uyuyu againe wadamiyami faꞋina, Kaiwabu yana tova keke ginavefutaꞋami tokaiꞋafu tonimanuwa uyuyuya givefutaꞋana amine.
Au omi moyaꞋaimi mahalina ana kaliva, yami dewa kabuꞋavane uyadeyadeya waseseyemaunena. E, ide keke uyuyu ana kaliva higa vaita bogi againe yada dewa sevasevauyana kadafifaisewani.
Ide mahalina ana kaliva faꞋina, keke kanadauda badi Yaubada keke hidahalamaneni-ma hidadauda amine. Au kanalulauboda ada taudeyao kanahawatada.
Au uyuyu againe kaliva hidadauda. Uyuyu againe kaliva gufa laulaugina hiyuyu-faꞋila be hivevekwavakwava.

Tu ide mahalina ana kaliva faꞋina, taudeyao kanahawatada. Vetumagana kadu nuwakabubu vaita manawada ana abaseboda amine kanaꞋosena. Ada kibababala ana lulauboda vaita gaviya ana kedukedu amine kanaꞋosena.
Keke vaita Yaubada yana ilaꞋa guwana kananuhagani faꞋina gidavenuwadadaneda, keke. Au givenuwadadaneda be yada Kaiwabu Yesu Keliso yana veluga againe kibababala kananuhagana.
BanaꞋe ide faꞋideya giꞋalika higa kaꞋi wayawaida kamimiyami o alikeya kaꞋenonuwaulu, au Bana buye kanamiyami faꞋina.
Medema faꞋina Kaiwabu ana vetumagana againe buye wanaveꞋalulauꞋage kadu buye wanaveꞋaveluveluga. Ada au wona velemona hidede amine mene wahuluhuluva.
Kivetuvetunu tulina tulina.
Tu tobohiyameyao aveꞋoꞋolemi toyogina be badi Kaiwabu givegidedi be omi tovetumagana ami yoꞋo hinafamiya hifififaisewa-ma wanawowomumuyedi. Badi hiꞋitaꞋitaveꞋavimi kadu hikivetuvetunumi.
Yadi faisewa hagihagina faꞋina yami waꞋasehawahega wanaveꞋamohimohinedi lakahina. Ada omi taumiyao veyao againe wanamiyami.

Kadu tobohiyameyao, agahevagadonemi be badi himiyamiya-kawowo wanaꞋagoꞋabiyedi, badi matamatauhidiyao aseꞋasedi wanakivevatuna, badi kowakowadiyao wanavelugadi, tobohiyamiyao moyaꞋaidi wanaꞋatuvefaꞋiledi.
Hai kaliva nuwanuwana koyona kadu koyona againe ginalaufata, medema wanahawatana. Au giluboda-moꞋemi be buye wanaveꞋanuwanuwakabubu, kadu meda mali kaliva moyaꞋaidi wananuwanuwakabubuyedi.
Tova moyaꞋaina wanavemwavemwamwala.
Tova be tova Yaubada againe wanaveꞋoveꞋoꞋola.
Gavadi gavadi moyaꞋaina agaimiya ginalakayemu, medema faꞋina Yaubada againe wanavesivesiule. Omi Yesu Keliso yana kaliva yana vevine faꞋina, Yaubada nuwanuwana omi medede amine wanahuluva.
AluꞋaluwa Mahalina yana faisewa keke wanahawatani.
Bana Yaubada yana venuwaꞋata tovetumagana gitunevehabalutugidi-ma keke wanahawaveꞋiyohoyohoyeni.
Gahe moyaꞋaina inubana kaꞋi Yaubada againe o kaꞋi keke ma wananuwaveꞋuveꞋuna. Hadema gahe velemoꞋena, medema wanavenogalena.
Koyona tulina tulina matatabuna wanavekwaulaugena.
ToꞋetoladi yadi lukafoi.

Kafoi tobohiyameyao, Bana Yaubada aseniwalova giveleveleda-ma ginaꞋihagihagiyemi be yana kaliva yana vevine mahamahali-moꞋemiyao wanamiyami. E, aveꞋoꞋola be nuwahinagemi matatabuna kadu wowomi matatabuna ginaꞋitaveꞋavina ginanunauwena tu yada Kaiwabu Yesu Keliso yana yewaꞋela ana toveya wanamiyami ami vita keke.
Bana gikovami be yana yoꞋogaga agaidiya waluku-ma au hidede amine agaimiya ginagugai, ada Bana giwonadabadaba amine ginagugaiyena faꞋina adafaiweya kanavetumaganena.
Tobohiyameyao, ime faꞋimeya wanaveꞋoꞋola.
Kafoi tobohiyameyao moyaꞋaimi. Ime faꞋimeya tobohiyamiyao wanaꞋatulauhidi higa yama nuwanuwa hawahawahegana agaimiya wadaseyemaunena.
Kaiwabu ana eganeya gavehimeyemi be tamo hakwadi tovetumagana ami yoꞋo agaimiya hida leta aꞋetoladina-ma tobohiyameyao moyaꞋaimi matamiya ginahawana.
Yada Kaiwabu Yesu Keliso yana nuwadogeya wanamiyami. (Ime Folo Sailosi Timoti bonama.)
